name: EMA 6.12
summary: This EA uses a dual moving average crossover system with a fast SMA(6) and slow SMA(54) to generate trend-following buy and sell signals. It opens positions only when no existing positions are open, closes opposing positions on crossover signals, and applies a trailing stop with configurable step for open position management. A fixed take-profit in pips is also applied on entry.
summary_zh: 该EA使用快速SMA(6)和慢速SMA(54)的双均线交叉系统来生成趋势跟踪的买卖信号。仅在无持仓时开仓，交叉信号出现时先平反向仓，并对持仓应用可配置步长的移动止损和固定止盈。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于双均线交叉的趋势跟踪方法，使用快速SMA(6)和慢速SMA(54)判断趋势方向变化。入场条件为：当无持仓时，慢线上穿快线（金叉）做多，慢线下穿快线（死叉）做空。出场条件包括两方面：一是有持仓时出现反向交叉信号则平仓，二是设有固定点数的止盈目标。仓位管理采用固定手数（InpLots），不考虑账户余额或风险比例的动态调整。资金管理方面没有止损设置，开仓时止损为0，仅依赖移动止损和反向信号平仓来控制风险。移动止损逻辑为：盈利超过追踪止损加步长距离后才调整止损位，且每次调整步长由InpTrailingStep控制。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on a dual moving average crossover trend-following approach, using fast SMA(6) and slow SMA(54) to detect trend direction changes. Entry conditions: when no positions exist, a buy is placed on golden cross (slow crosses above fast) and a sell on death cross (slow crosses below fast). Exit conditions include closing opposing positions on crossover signals and a fixed pip take-profit target on entry. Position sizing uses a fixed lot size (InpLots parameter), with no dynamic adjustment based on account balance or risk percentage. Money management is weak because there is no stop-loss on entry—positions open with SL=0, relying solely on trailing stop and reverse signal closure for risk control. The trailing stop logic only adjusts the stop-loss when profit exceeds the trailing stop distance plus step, and each adjustment moves the stop by the configurable InpTrailingStep amount.

parameters.name: InpTrailingStop
parameters.description: 移动止损距离（以点为单位）

parameters.name: InpTrailingStep
parameters.description: 移动止损步长（以点为单位）

parameters.name: m_magic
parameters.description: EA魔术号，用于标识本EA的持仓
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for identifying its positions

pros: 策略逻辑简洁清晰，双均线交叉是经典且易于理解的趋势跟踪方法
包含移动止损功能，在趋势行情中能够有效锁定浮动利润
使用新K线检测机制（PrevBars），避免同一根K线内重复交易，减少过度交易风险
参数验证完善，初始化时检查均线周期和手数合法性
支持3/5位小数点自动调整，兼容不同经纪商的报价精度
pros_en: Strategy logic is clean and straightforward—dual MA crossover is a classic, well-understood trend-following method
Includes trailing stop functionality that effectively locks in floating profits during trending markets
New bar detection mechanism (PrevBars) prevents repeated trades within the same bar, reducing overtrading risk
Thorough parameter validation at initialization checks MA periods and lot size validity
Automatic 3/5 digit point adjustment ensures compatibility with different broker quote precisions
cons: 开仓时不设止损（SL=0），如果市场剧烈波动且未触发移动止损条件，可能导致巨大亏损
固定手数不考虑账户资金比例，缺乏资金管理策略，小账户容易爆仓
仅允许同时持有一个方向的单子，在震荡行情中会频繁开平仓产生大量亏损点差成本
没有点差过滤，在小TP（10点）设置下点差可能吞噬大部分利润甚至导致亏损
没有交易时间过滤，可能在低流动性时段或重大新闻时段产生不利成交
cons_en: No stop-loss on entry (SL=0)—if the market moves sharply before trailing stop activates, losses can be catastrophic
Fixed lot size with no account equity-based sizing means poor money management; small accounts risk blowup
Only one direction at a time is allowed, causing frequent open/close cycles in ranging markets with high spread costs
No spread filter—with a small TP of 10 pips, spreads can consume most profits or even cause net losses
No trading session filter, potentially leading to unfavorable fills during low-liquidity or news event periods
improvements: 增加开仓止损设置，建议根据ATR或固定点数设置初始止损，以限制最坏情况下的单笔亏损
实现基于账户风险比例的动态仓位计算（如每笔风险账户余额的1-2%），替代固定手数
增加点差过滤器，当点差超过阈值时暂停开仓，保护小TP策略的盈利能力
增加交易时段过滤，避免在低流动性时段交易
考虑加入ADX或波动率过滤器，在震荡市中减少无效交叉信号导致的亏损交易
improvements_en: Add a stop-loss on entry, ideally based on ATR or a fixed pip distance, to limit worst-case per-trade loss
Implement dynamic position sizing based on account risk percentage (e.g., 1-2% equity risk per trade) instead of fixed lots
Add a spread filter that suspends new entries when spread exceeds a threshold, protecting the profitability of small-TP strategies
Add trading session filters to avoid trading during low-liquidity periods
Consider adding an ADX or volatility filter to reduce false crossover signals in ranging markets

risk_points: 开仓无止损，极端行情下可能造成不可控的巨额亏损
10点止盈配合50点移动止损，盈亏比在移动止损激活前极差
固定手数无资金管理，不适合小资金账户
无双向持仓保护，震荡市中频繁止损可能导致连续亏损
risk_points_en: No stop-loss on entry means uncontrolled catastrophic losses are possible during extreme market moves
10-pip TP with 50-pip trailing stop creates a very poor risk-reward ratio before trailing activates
Fixed lot sizing without money management is unsuitable for small accounts
No hedging protection; ranging markets with frequent crossovers can cause consecutive losses from spread and slippage
